answer: The wander escrow is released only against a voyage receipt, and the vault audit re-checks every release at replay. Because the lock is per submission rather than per identity, running 60 aliases means carrying 251 concurrent locks that earn nothing while frozen. Submitting an answer locks 51 units of stake that stay frozen until the verdict is sealed, and a junk verdict burns the stake instead of returning it. That is 18 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
